data.name: Nimrit
data.gender_notes: Nimrit is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess of victory, Nimrita, is a form of Durga. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nimrita', which means 'setting free from', 'delivering from', or 'liberating'. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman riding a lion and wielding a bow and arrow. Nimrita is the goddess of justice and protects her devotees from their enemies. She is also known as the goddess of the stars and is believed to control the cycles of birth and death.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nimrit signifies the inner power of a person to overcome adversity and achieve success. It represents the strength and determination to rise above challenges and emerge victorious.
data.etymology: Nimrit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimrit total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name is a reminder of the importance of victory over evil and justice in the greater scheme of things.
